title: Rayhunter companion: Android app to install and manage orbic/tplink devices
body:
https://codeberg.org/untitaker/rayhunter-companion

apks: https://codeberg.org/untitaker/rayhunter-companion/releases

> This app allows you to store a list of WiFi networks that run [Rayhunter](https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter), and connect to any of them to open Rayhunter's admin UI in a WebView.

> Once you are connected to a device, Rayhunter Companion will show a permanent notification reflecting the state of the green/red line on the device (THIS IS CURRENTLY UNRELIABLE)

> The app also includes experimental functionality to run the installer directly from the phone against a given device. This only works for network-based installers (tplink, orbic), but not for example orbic-usb or uz801.

**This is not an official app, and entirely experimental.** It also will lag behind on the latest release of rayhunter, as the release process is manual.
